objective: Computation on the 191 saved exact maps. Record how the four far sides relate (which create together), how creation looks at atom lines and at glue lines, and whether each Fano atom acts as one from outside: every atom line outside it receiving the same far-side pattern from each of its lines.
status: Proved by exact computation on the 191 saved maps: the Fano plane and census 58 create at the same pairs, K4^(3) only where census 6 does, census 6 without the Fano plane only at glue lines; at atom lines creation has four strengths; every Fano atom acts as one from outside (731 of 731)
title: The far-side map
